methodology: Post-hoc order-only diagnosis using held-out reference; no ground truth enters training or ranking. Equality of row multisets does not prove reference error or establish an intended order.

tasks.description: Every predicted row has the same cell multiset as its corresponding reference row, but at least one cell position differs.
